ledger.note: 637: the Gauda kingdom is divided. Shashanka's son Manava 'ruled the kingdom for eight months' after Shashanka's death (infobox 636); 'Gauda was soon divided amongst Harshavardhana and Bhaskarvarmana of Kamarupa', Bhaskaravarman 'even managing to conquer Karnasuvarna'. The pages give no year; 637 follows Shashanka's 636 plus Manava's eight months and the Kamarupa dossier's 637.

wars.name: Shashanka's attack on Kannauj and the killing of Rajyavardhana
wars.outcome: 'c. 606 C.E. Rajyavardhana was killed by Shashanka' (no conclusive evidence); the Maukhari king Grahavarman was killed by Devagupta of Malwa c. 605; Harsha, ruler of Thanesar in 606, then attacked Kannauj. No land stayed with Gauda.

wars.name: Shashanka's wars with Harsha and Kamarupa
wars.outcome: Attacks on Kamarupa 'between 595 and 600 C.E.'; Shashanka 'continued to rule Gauda with frequent attacks from Harsha' and defended Vanga and Samatata against him (undated). After Shashanka's death Bhaskaravarman took Karnasuvarna.
wars.note: The page dates none of the Harsha fighting.

certainty.note: The pages describe a domain 'from Vanga to Bhuvanesha' bordering Kamarupa and give no border line.

notes: Two pages. Cliopatria has a single 90,000 km2 shape for 602-611; the infobox gives 554-636 and Shashanka 593-636. This dossier lives 554-637, stretching the shape back to 554 and forward to 637, adds the Bengal land Cliopatria gives the Maukharis, and adds Odisha (undated). All of that is the researcher's reading of 'Gauda and Vanga ... the whole of Bengal' and 'from Vanga to Bhuvanesha'. The dissolve is 637 (Shashanka 636 + Manava's eight months; Kamarupa dossier 637); the page gives no year. The kingdom's origins before 593 (Jayanaga as a possible Gauda king, Middleton) are not on these pages. Shashanka's Magadha/Bodh Gaya episode is undated and not drawn. later-gupta-dynasty (sa-02 dossier exists) is the counterpart of the 602 gain: it has Magadha returning to the Later Guptas c. 606 with Harsha. Gazetteer: Karnasuvarna, Samatata are not places.
